title: Recording: Call Me by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Producers Workshop, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr recorded ‘Call Me’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 26 July 1974.

‘Call Me’ was the only song won the album which was entirely written by Starr.

The backing track had David Foster on piano, Steve Cropper on guitar, and Klaus Voormann on bass guitar and backing vocals. Also on vocals were Lon Van Eaton, Derrek Van Eaton, Vini Poncia, Richard Perry, Cynthia Webb, and Vini Poncia.
